decisions.reason: Because this service is very close to the core maritime support offer, uses existing travel and crew-management capabilities, and is relatively cheap to keep open while it supports customer relationships, we would retain it.

After several years the digital portal should already have revealed whether it creates enough customer value, and with weak visible traction and ongoing maintenance needs, the option value now looks lower than reallocating resources elsewhere.

The mobile performance app is an adjacent digital option with continued upkeep costs and, by 2022, limited evidence of strong standalone payoff, so we would abandon it and redeploy resources to stronger core and new opportunities.
